cases.title: Asian Level 3 Virgin Hair to Clean Level 8 Ash Blonde
cases.clinical_challenge: 5-level lift through dense dark core. Requires powerful lift + cool anti-brass toner.

stages_detail.instructions:
Step 1 • PREPARATION: Dry, unwashed hair. Section into 4 equal quadrants with sectioning clips. Apply skin barrier cream around hairline and ears.
Step 2 • DIGITAL SCALE MIXING: Place bowl on digital scale, tare to 0.0g. Weigh 60.0g of 8-1 and 60.0g of Schwarzkopf Professional Igora Royal Oil Developer 9% (30 Vol) (1:1 ratio). Whisk with colour whisk until completely homogeneous.
Step 3 • APPLICATION: Using a professional tint brush, apply in fine 0.5 cm slices starting from roots / regrowth. If refreshing lengths, pull through with wide-tooth comb during the final 10–15 minutes.
Step 4 • PROCESSING: Dwell for 45 minutes at room temperature. Do NOT apply artificial heat.
Step 5 • EMULSIFY & RINSE: Add a small splash of lukewarm water, massage hairline for 2 minutes to lift stains, then rinse until water runs completely clear. Follow with post-colour pH-neutralizing shampoo and conditioner.
